example.title: Beachwear shop in a painted block building
example.place: Pismo Beach, San Luis Obispo County, CA

brief: A c. 1970 small single-storey shop: cream-painted concrete block with a turquoise-framed door and display windows full of beach clothes and hats, a painted signboard with a surfer and the shop name, next to a pink stucco neighbour, a palm trunk at the kerb. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

storefronts.sign: PENNY'S · BEACH & HOLIDAY ATTIRE FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
